environment: Owned networked development moon and disposable test vault
source: The development Connect and Urbitwarden app files and vault-key library matched the checked-out 0.2.0 release sources inspected on this date

observations.recovery: An older retained encrypted key wrapper replaced only the newer wrapper. The account ID and one encrypted item were preserved.
observations.signedMacDesktop2026_10_1: Fresh Connect SSO and local unlock displayed the retained item with its expected fields.
observations.officialCli2026_10_0: A separate fresh profile completed Connect SSO, local unlock, sync and decryption of the retained item and expected fields.
observations.chromium: The ship page loaded and its refreshed vault summary reported one item.
observations.cleanup: The disposable recovery ship was stopped and its temporary pier, vault copy and access-code file were removed.

limits: The previous password was restored before these fresh-client checks. They do not establish independent-client reauthentication with the post-change password after the native desktop password change.
The desktop item was displayed after unlock; this check does not claim a confirmed desktop Sync now completion signal.
The ship page reports unencrypted item-count metadata and does not decrypt vault contents.
